hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and midground along the curb.

hazards.name: Degraded Roadway Pavement
hazards.description: The asphalt is heavily cracked and pitted, creating tripping hazards for pedestrians crossing mid-block.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Trash cans and a bicycle are placed directly in the narrow walking path, forcing pedestrians to navigate around them.
hazards.location_in_image: On the sidewalk in front of the white and red brick houses

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: There is no horizontal separation or vertical barrier between the sidewalk and the travel lane.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked cars along both sides of the street can block the view between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicle
hazards.description: A large pickup truck parked at the curb completely blocks the sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and any oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalk Continuity
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the right side appears to terminate or become unpaved near the vacant lot, creating an inaccessible path.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, mid-ground

hazards.name: Absence of Pedestrian Crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks visible, requiring pedestrians to cross the two-lane road without designated protection.

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: The concrete walkway is cracked and uneven in several places, creating a trip hazard.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian-Vehicle Separation
hazards.description: There is no physical buffer or vertical element separating the wide walking area from the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Edge of the paved area adjacent to the asphalt

hazards.name: Overgrown Vegetation
hazards.description: Dense weeds and grass have completely overtaken sections of the sidewalk on the left, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground and mid-ground along the sidewalk
